summary: Remove the opt-in HTTP/streamable MCP transport entirely; the MCP server is stdio-only. No network listener exists, so no reachable caller can invoke tools with the process-bound Exa credentials without authentication.
reason: Greptile policy gate requires 4/5 confidence; the security review escalated to 'HTTP MCP transport has no caller authentication'. The manifest only advertises stdio (command/args/env), so removing the unused HTTP surface eliminates the finding class without losing any advertised capability.
validated_outcome: go build ./... passes; manifest.json unchanged (stdio-only already); SKILL/README reference no HTTP transport.
